name: mutation-guided-testing
description: Opt-in proof of concept: makes the tests an agent writes catch bugs, not just raise coverage. Inside the red-green-refactor loop it names 3 to 5 concrete bugs from a risk checklist before the code, proves a test fails for each, runs Gremlins, mutmut or StrykerJS on the diff only, and triages a capped, ranked list of survivors. No percentage gate.
